title: Figures 4.11-4.12: IEC Equipotential Surfaces in STAR Mode and Ion Energy Distributions
description: Figure 4.11 is a diagram of a spherical IEC cathode grid with labeled equipotential surfaces, cathode grid wires, entering ions, exiting ions, ion beam and focal point, captioned 'Diagram Showing Equipotential Surfaces of the IEC Cathode Grid and Their Focusing Effect on a Beam of Ions in the Star Mode Discharge at High Voltages (> 50 keV)'. Figure 4.12 is a chart titled 'Ion Energy Distributions 1st pass, 2 cm grid radius, 50 kV, 4.6 mTorr' plotting number of ions versus ion energy (0-60000 eV) for ions entering grid, at center, and leaving grid.
